title: Yet here’s a spot.
html_source: Lady MacBeth says this in her madness, washing her hands in Macbeth, Vi. The spots she sees on her hands are blood, and thus they represent her guilt as a murderess and regicide.

anchor.prefix:
ar of his tennis shirt spoke: 

 — I intend to make a collection of your sayings if you will let me. 

 Speaking to me. They wash and tub and scrub. Agenbite of inwit. Conscience.
